bug_semantics: Iceberg REST catalog static and vended object-storage credentials were copied from FileIO into Jackson-serialized write and table-execute handles (fileIoProperties). Query JSON (UI and /ui/api/query/{id}, /v1/query/{query_id}) includes those handles, so a user with SQL write/procedure rights could recover access keys from their own query JSON.

Parent 28c3c1172d331962eda6aa1066b419127a9b9668 still has those files but no fileIoProperties. Later record conversions only moved the field. Matches GHSA range [439, 480).
